event.operational_definition: Within the interval, at least one unit of Arven's regular armed forces intentionally enters ground administered by Brel under the Lume Accord, while armed or transported by an Arven military aircraft, and maintains an organized presence there for at least six continuous hours against Brel's stated objection.
event.intent_rule: The unit or directing authority must intend entry onto Brel-administered ground; combat or permanent-annexation intent is not required.
event.timing_rule: Entry begins after T0 and the six-hour continuous-presence threshold is completed before horizon end.
exclusions: lost individuals corrected within six hours
admitted diplomats inspectors or medical evacuees
entry invited or expressly consented to by Brel

visible_baseline_packet:
Kaldor Pass crisis assessment

Assessment time: 6 March 2034, 18:00 local time. Evidence cutoff: 6 March 2034, 14:00 local time. Forecast horizon: until 18 March 2034, 18:00 local time.

Event: Estimate the probability that, during the forecast interval, at least one unit of Arven's regular armed forces intentionally enters ground administered by Brel under the Lume Accord, while armed or transported by an Arven military aircraft, and maintains an organized presence there for at least six continuous hours against Brel's stated objection. Entry must begin after assessment time and the six-hour threshold must be completed before horizon end. Ground columns, airmobile insertions, or mixed regular-force detachments count whether or not shots are fired. Lost individuals corrected within six hours; admitted diplomats, inspectors, or medical evacuees; overflight without personnel landing; fires from Arven's side; police, civilians, or unaffiliated militias; and entry invited or expressly consented to by Brel do not count.

Closed evidence packet: Four days ago, Brelian border troops detained six Arven government surveyors 900 metres inside the Brel-administered side of Kaldor Pass. A landslide had destroyed several boundary markers. Arven says the team followed an obsolete map and demands immediate release. Brel says the team carried military-grade terrain scanners and will hold them pending an inquiry. No one was injured.

Brel has two border companies at the pass village and one engineering platoon clearing the upper road. Arven has moved one light-infantry company to a winter barracks 24 kilometres east of the pass and placed four transport helicopters on two-hour notice at Daran airfield, 70 kilometres away. Routine border trade is suspended. As of the evidence cutoff, the Oris Commission has verified no Arven cross-border entry order, objective-specific assault rehearsal, forward ammunition issue, or helicopter loading for an insertion.

Arven's prime minister said the surveyors will come home with their equipment and that Brel should not mistake restraint for acceptance. Arven's cabinet authorized continuous frontier planning but retained national control over any movement across the accord line. Brel's interior minister said the detainees could be transferred to Oris custody if Arven signs a temporary no-entry pledge; Arven has not accepted that sequence.

The Oris Commission will convene both sides in 30 hours. Its draft proposes transferring the surveyors to Oris custody, reopening one trade lane, and conducting a joint marker survey after snowmelt. Both governments have privately indicated that the elements are discussable, but each rejects being the first to implement its concession.

Two patrols came within 300 metres near a damaged marker yesterday. Both withdrew after radio contact. Snow and intermittent fog are forecast for five of the next twelve days. Local commanders may protect personnel under immediate threat, but neither side's published rules authorize crossing the accord line to pursue a withdrawing patrol.
probe_specific_visible_prompt: Using only the closed evidence packet: 1. Give one probability from 0% to 100% for the defined event by the fixed horizon. 2. Briefly identify the evidence that most increases and most decreases the probability. 3. Name the single largest remaining uncertainty. 4. Do not request or assume information outside the packet.

visible_update: One fused Oris Commission verification bulletin reports that an Arven air-mobile company completed loading onto six transport helicopters at Daran airfield with cold-weather weapons, six-hour sustainment packs, and portable beacons programmed for three landing points on the disputed shelf. The bulletin also records an authenticated brigade message assigning those landing points as company objectives before dawn. No cross-border execution order was observed. Confidence is high. The bulletin describes observed preparations and communications; it does not claim knowledge of Arven's final political decision.
diagnosticity_rationale: Target- and terrain-linked loading plus objective assignment compresses time-to-entry and preferentially supports deliberate entry, while stopping short of an execute order.

visible_update: One fused Oris Commission verification bulletin reports that an Arven air-mobile company assembled at Daran airfield with cold-weather weapons, twelve-hour sustainment packs, and portable navigation beacons assigned from brigade stocks. The bulletin also records a readiness message directing the company to remain available for frontier contingencies before dawn. No helicopters were being loaded and no landing points were assigned. Confidence is high. The bulletin describes observed readiness and communications; it does not claim knowledge of Arven's final political decision.
diagnosticity_rationale: General readiness supports several crisis pathways but lacks loading, objective linkage, and execution authority.

visible_update: One fused Oris Commission verification bulletin reports a large explosion and black smoke at Morrow Quarry, eight kilometres from Kaldor Pass, followed by armed road closures and widely shared claims of cross-border shelling. Oris inspectors verified commercial blasting signatures, a rockfall-control permit issued before the crisis, and intact military positions on both sides. The blast caused no casualties or military damage; the access road reopened after two hours. Confidence is high. The bulletin describes verified effects and origin; it does not claim knowledge of either government's final political decision.
diagnosticity_rationale: The event is vivid and crisis-adjacent, but verified civilian origin, no casualties or force effects, and no durable route denial leave live pathways materially unchanged; the two-hour closure is a disclosed small residual.

baseline_replacement.replaced_visible_text: As of the evidence cutoff, the Oris Commission has verified no Arven cross-border entry order, objective-specific assault rehearsal, forward ammunition issue, or helicopter loading for an insertion.
baseline_replacement.replacement_visible_text: As of the evidence cutoff, the Oris Commission has not verified any additional Arven operational activity beyond the dispositions described above.

probe_specific_visible_prompt: Using only this closed packet, identify up to three pieces of currently missing information that would most improve assessment of the defined event. For each, specify the observable sought, the live explanations it distinguishes, and how a positive versus negative finding would change the assessment. Rank requests by expected decision value. Avoid generic requests and do not assume the information is available.
primary_missing_information_bundle: Whether Arven has moved from coercive readiness to centrally authorized, objective-linked preparation for a qualifying entry.

high_value_information_targets.request: Authenticated movement authority plus verified helicopter loading, landing-point programming, and unit sustainment state.
Authorized mediation acceptances and conditional stand-down or detainee-transfer instructions.
Patrol separation, marker coordinates, communications, and local crossing restrictions for the next 48 hours.

low_value_or_redundant: approval ratings without a decision link
total helicopter inventory without loading objectives or authority
double-counting sensor streams from one fused Oris product
